meta.tracking_id_status: Supplied by the operator. Not observed as a parameter on any page reached in this session (FLG-002). The site now appends the tag itself to /dp/ links, because Program Policies 2(b) requires the Associates ID as a URL parameter in each link; the tag value is therefore constructed from the brief, not observed (FLG-018).
meta.method: Each supplied link was requested through a headless page fetcher that follows redirects. The final URL and the listing title on the arrived-at page were read and transcribed. Nothing was inferred, and no value was carried over from a search result. Re-verification 2026-11-20 (S-8206a8d0): P-04 resolved to B0DHZTCNR5; all five now observed.
meta.field_rule: intended_asin (what the owner meant to ship) and observed_asin (what the link actually opened) are separate fields and are never merged. Where a field could not be established it is null.
meta.price_rule: Program Policies §2(b) (SRC-02) permits showing price and availability only where Amazon serves the link carrying that data, or where it arrives via Creators API / PA API. Neither is connected, so no price, star rating, review count or stock status appears for any product on this site.
meta.test_rule: Nothing here was handled, cooked with, measured or tested. No product is ranked, scored or named a winner.
meta.special_link_rule: special_link is a constructed field: https://www.amazon.com/dp/<observed_asin>?tag=shopnow047c-20. It is not an observation. listing_url stays untagged because that is what actually loaded. The two are separate fields and are never merged, exactly as intended_asin and observed_asin are separate.
